overview: PondyOne is a hyper-local three-tier platform for Puducherry and Chennai featuring Customer, Business Owner, and Founder Admin interfaces with mobile-first design, INR payments, and role-based experiences.
features: Admin owner verification with instant badge and toast feedback
PWA manifest for mobile install and offline support
Owner product edit modals for Stay, Play, and Retail listings
Full CRUD for all four listing categories (Food, Stay, Play, Retail)
Mobile-first responsive design with bottom navigation
